api.name: deleteSnapshot
api.description: Deletes a Snapshot of a disk volume.

params.name: expectedscopehash
params.description: Optional scopehash from dryrun; reject deletion if its target or state has changed

params.name: zoneid
params.description: The ID of the zone for the snapshot

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the Snapshot

params.name: force
params.description: Administrator recovery: attempt physical deletion and tombstone unresolved metadata, retaining pending cleanup audit. Requires dryrun scopehash.

params.name: dryrun
params.description: Diagnose the exact deletion scope and residual references without modifying the snapshot

response.name: physicalcleanupcomplete
response.description: All identified physical targets settled and no pending audit remains; unknown mappings cannot prove absence

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: zoneid
response.description: Selected zone UUID; absent for all zones

response.name: dbcleanupcomplete
response.description: Selected database metadata was logically deleted

response.name: scopehash
response.description: Revision of the diagnosed deletion scope

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: cleanupresult
response.description: Forced cleanup plan or per-reference results

response.name: referenceid
response.description: Store reference ID, or zero for unmapped metadata

response.name: reference
response.description: Store references in the selected scope

response.name: state
response.description: Reference state; Hidden retains a dependency chain

response.name: pendingcleanup
response.description: Unverified physical target audit entries retained for inspection or retry
